items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: We used to look at him, man, all the kids in the band... Because we was all kids together... Pete and I, we quit in Wichita, Kansas... We called him Bub.

ctx.x: Did he teach Prez this, too?

No. Prez could play it natural. Because he had a good talent to play that. When he'd play a solo, he played them in there anyway. I mean, that's where his ear could tell him to do that. We used to look at him, man, all the kids in the band... Because we was all kids together. Maybe I'm about three or four or five years older than Prez, something like that. But we was all together, and we used to look at him, man... We didn't call him Prez. We called him Bub. That's what his father... They called him Bub. Lee…
